body.p: Claims 1-20 are pending in the current application and are subject to a Restriction requirement. The Office has required restriction to one of the following alleged species:
Group I: Species A (Claims 1-8), described in FIG. 3, drawn to selecting a
driving mode using a paddle shifter;
Group II: Species B (Claims 9-20), described in FIG. 5, drawn to
recommending a driving mode based on a driving environment. Applicant hereby elects Group II, Species B directed to claims 9-20, with traverse.

For a restriction requirement to be proper, the alleged inventions must be independent or distinct and there must be a serious search and/or examination burden if restriction were not required. Applicant respectfully submits that it would not be unduly burdensome to simultaneously examine all the claims in the present application concurrently. In particular, the claims of Group I and Group II both recite selection of a driving mode with a paddle shifter. Accordingly, art directed to selecting a driving mode with a paddle shifter will be identified with respect to examination of either Group. That is, in examining the claims of alleged Group II, references drawn to selecting a driving mode using a paddle shifter will necessarily be search and, if found, reviewed. Accordingly, there would be no substantial or increased burden on the Examiner to examine all groups concurrently.

In view of the above remarks, Applicant respectfully submits that the application is now in condition for allowance. The Examiner is encouraged to contact the undersigned to resolve efficiently any formal matters or to discuss any aspects of the application or of this response. Otherwise, early notification of allowable subject matter is respectfully requested.

The Director is hereby authorized to charge all required fees (including any extension of time fees) and to credit any overpayment of fees in this and any concurrent or future correspondence to Deposit Account No. 041133.
